what: Story events for examples/wing-it, read by eye from frames of assets/wing_v.mp4 (the vertical cut of WING IT! from film 82.0 s to 112.0 s). t is seconds into the cut, film_s is the same moment in the film (82.0 + t). build/index.template.htm holds the same numbers in ITEMS, GADGETS and literal cue times; change both together.

checklist.frame: the cat is yanked upside down out of his seat
the cut to the rocket in the barn; it sits still until about 3.9 and jolts upward at 4.0
a hole in the roof and a smoke trail; the rocket left the frame between 4.5 and 4.6, so the check comes about 0.4 s after it
the rocket passes the moon above the clouds; no single event, a moment picked inside the ascent shot
the umbrella is inside out; it flips between 21.6 and 21.8
the cut to the cockpit; the rooster comes through the windshield at about 29.2

gadgets.name: PLUNGER
gadgets.frame: first shows at about 25.07, on top of the hull

gadgets.name: LIFE RING
gadgets.frame: first shows at about 25.17, left of the hull

gadgets.name: BALLOON
gadgets.frame: red, left of the hull from about 25.9

gadgets.name: RAFT
gadgets.frame: yellow, below the hull from about 26.3

gadgets.name: BOXING GLOVE
gadgets.frame: punches out of the front grille

cues.what: checklist card slides down; the six chips follow from 0.4, 0.06 s apart
giant 3
giant 2
giant 1
white flash and a shake on the IGNITION check
shake on the LIFTOFF check
label ROOF: OPTIONAL, held 1.2 s
shake, G-force in the cockpit
shake
altitude meter slides in; bar and number run from 7.7 to 11.1, 0 to 12,000 FT; it leaves at 12.0 and is gone by 12.3
warning MASTER CAUTION
warning HULL: MOSTLY TAPE
warning PILOT: STILL SMILING; the warnings blink every 0.5 s from 12.8 and leave at 17.5
step card NEXT STEP / DEPLOY PARACHUTE, as a finger presses the parachute button
label ...that's an umbrella, as the umbrella opens
step card turns red: RESULT / PARACHUTE: FAILED, with a shake
giant PLAN B over the screaming cat
EMERGENCY GADGETS counter comes in at 0; each gadget sets it and adds a chip
gadget counter and chips fade out
flash, shake and a BIRD STRIKE tape on the AIRSPACE check
tape fades out
the last frame of the footage (assets/last.jpg) is shown as a still
footage ends; a dark shade fades in; CHECKLIST 3/6, GADGETS 7, BIRDS 1 and nobody told them about the umbrella come in at 30.16, 30.41, 30.66 and 30.96
end

ducked.why: a shouted swear at film 1:42 to 1:44

checked: Every checklist time and every gadget time was checked afterwards with frame grabs of assets/wing_v.mp4; what each frame shows is in the frame fields. Gadget marks land within about 0.1 s of the frame where each gadget first shows.
